summary: Re-tested the 3 previously blocked checks of the 2-step association registration flow in /app/frontend/app/register-association.js after the PostgreSQL restore. All 3 checks PASS. (1) With code 'ASCB' the debounced check-code call returns taken; UI shows red XCircle + 'Ce code est déjà utilisé' and register-create-button is aria-disabled=true. (2) With a unique random code (ZZTEST12342) the UI shows green CheckCircle + 'Code disponible !' and register-create-button becomes enabled. (3) Full email/password creation path (register-admin-name, unique register-admin-phone, register-admin-password/confirm >=8, Suivant, register-assoc-name + unique register-assoc-code, click register-create-button) triggers POST /public/associations/register successfully and the success screen displays with the association code, 'Association créée avec succès !' title and the 'Continuer vers mon tableau de bord' button. Backend GET /public/associations/check-code/ASCB -> {available:false,reason:'taken'} and unique code -> {available:true} confirmed via curl on port 8001.

action_items: Investigate and clean up the 'Unexpected text node' React Native web warnings in register-association.js JSX (stray whitespace or empty expression inside a <View>).
Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (project-wide, low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: Debounce timer is 500ms as documented; combined with API latency, ~600-800ms wait is realistic before feedback appears — matches observed behavior.
register-create-button uses disabled + createButtonDisabled style based on codeStatus !== 'available' — behavior verified end-to-end.
